scripts.build: npm run build -w @uichat-mira/docs && npm run build -w @uichat-mira/docs-site
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @uichat-mira/docs && npm run dev -w @uichat-mira/docs-site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @uichat-mira/docs && npm run build -w @uichat-mira/docs && npm run typecheck -w @uichat-mira/docs-site
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test -w @uichat-mira/docs && npm run build -w @uichat-mira/docs-site
scripts.test: npm run build -w @uichat-mira/docs && npm run test -w @uichat-mira/docs
scripts.release:check: npm run validate && npm run pack:verify -w @uichat-mira/docs
